messages:
Mira Patel: Heads-up — premerge SAST job failing in CI for several PRs. Error shows `KMS: decrypt failed` when retrieving evidence attachments. Anyone seen this pattern?
sec-bot: CI run 1765432199 triggered: sast-runner-42. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1765432199 :warning:
Alex Wang: I'm seeing same in infra — keystore service returned 403 for service-account `ci-runner@redwood-internal`. Possibly RBAC binding removed during yesterday's keystore tidy.
Sam Walker: We did a privilege sweep last night; I thought CI SA was exempt. Checking audit logs now. Give me a minute.
Sam Walker: Audit: found policy change at 2023-11-20T23:14Z — binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` removed from `ci-runner` by `ops-rotations` job.
Mira Patel: Ugh. We need ephemeral grants for triage. Can we push a short-lived grant so SAST unblocks? Need owner signoff for evidence retention change.
Alex Wang: Proposed fix: add ephemeral grant window 30m via keystore-admins; command:
```
# grant decrypt for 30m
kmsctl grant --principal=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-internal --key=projects/p/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/keystore --duration=30m
```
Sam Walker: I'll run that if security approves. Also will attach audit proof: request_id=req-59321.
Jen Ortiz: Oncall approves temporary grant for triage; but require follow-up ticket to re-evaluate role scoping and add CI SA to a stable rolebinding.
Mira Patel: Agree. Can we also add a CI check to fail loudly with actionable hint (link to remediation doc) instead of generic decrypt failure?
Alex Wang: Yes. I'll add a small error wrapper on the keystore client and open PR. Patch will include: shortlink to docs, and include `audit_request_id` in error logs.
Sam Walker: Done — granted 30m (req-59321), CI back to passing for impacted PRs. Leaving notes in incident ticket #SEC-412.
Mira Patel: Thanks all. Action items: Alex -> PR for better error, Sam -> create perm-change RFC + add CI SA to stable role, Jen -> confirm closure after 24h. Closing from thread in 2h unless someone objects. :thumbsup:
